pivHint: A SEAL is a sleek, whiskered ocean mammal. As a verb, you SEAL a deal when you finally ______ it.
winText: Deal done. SEAL was the pivot - from a whiskered ocean swimmer to the moment you CLOSE a deal.
lossText: CLOSE - to finish or shut. SEAL was the pivot: a SEAL is an ocean animal, but to SEAL a deal, an envelope, or a jar is to CLOSE it firmly.
